title: Activa 6G DLX (Classic Heritage)
description: The Honda Activa 6G DLX (Classic Heritage) is combines low-slung road presence with generous low-end torque rumble, positioned in the Commuter Scooter segment for riders demanding engaging everyday dynamics. Its tuned powertrain delivers immediate, tractable torque against a curb weight of 108 kg, ensuring responsive roll-on acceleration in demanding road conditions. The cockpit is configured with an Step-Through Upright riding stance and an accessible 765mm seat height that allows easy flat-footing for virtually all rider heights, making daily city navigation as intuitive as weekend backroad escapes.
